basics.name: Zeyu Bian
basics.label: PhD Student
basics.summary: First-year PhD student at the Halıcıoğlu Data Science Institute at the University of California, San Diego. Research interests lie broadly in modern AI, with a focus on optimization and learning theory.

work.name: University of Science and Technology of China
work.summary: PI: Prof. Tianhao Wang. Project: Towards Understanding Momentum Acceleration in River-Valley Loss Landscape. Analyzed gradient descent with heavy-ball momentum under recently proposed river-valley loss landscape. Theoretically showed that momentum can accelerate the progress along the river by enabling use of a substantially larger learning rate. Validated the insights with experiments on synthetic functions and language model training.
highlights: Analyzed gradient descent with heavy-ball momentum under river-valley loss landscape
Theoretically showed momentum acceleration with larger learning rates
Validated insights with experiments on synthetic functions and language model training

work.name: Yale University, Department of Biostatistics
work.summary: PI: Prof. Hongyu Zhao. Project: Larger SNP List and Functional Annotations Help to Boost Polygenic Risk Scores (PRS) Accuracy. Used PLINK to perform data cleaning and quality control for multi-population with raw 1000 Genomes Project (1KGP) genotype data. Developed revised hierarchical Bayesian model based on JointPRS to incorporate functional annotations and account for larger SNP list. Enhanced model performance across various traits by introducing self-adaptive hyperparameters.
highlights: Performed data cleaning and quality control for multi-population genotype data
Developed revised hierarchical Bayesian model based on JointPRS
Enhanced model performance with self-adaptive hyperparameters
Benchmarked model performance on simulated and real datasets
